collection.title: MAXUS T90EV 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a MAXUS T90EV 2022 Onwards model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
